name: Stealth
description: Anonymous model namespace used for the Ox Alpha stealth preview. OpenRouter later attributed Ox Alpha to Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash, but the historical stealth identity is retained separately.

sources.notes: OpenRouter identifies the historical namespace as stealth and reports that Ox Alpha was revealed as Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash.

verification.notes: This is a historical anonymous namespace, not a provider organisation and not a routing target.
